name: All India Pincode Directory snapshot (office level)
sourceLicense: MIT (repository); source data is attributed by the repository README to the Government of India data.gov.in All India Pincode Directory resource
notes: The publisher does not state an as-of date for the rows. The source revision date above is the CSV commit date, not an inferred postal-office effective date. This snapshot includes CircleName, RegionName, DivisionName, OfficeName, Pincode, OfficeType, Delivery, District, StateName, Latitude and Longitude. It does not include city or taluk; cityOrTaluk therefore remains null until an administrator confirms a label. The 39 duplicate identifying tuples in this snapshot are retained as distinct source rows; sourceKey hashes the complete source row and its deterministic duplicate occurrence ordinal.
